title: Task Scheduler with Cooldown
prompt: You are given a list of tasks (as characters) and a cooldown period `n`: the same task type must be separated by at least `n` other tasks (or idle slots) — analogous to scheduling the same GPU job type with a mandatory cooldown between runs. Return the minimum number of time units needed to finish all tasks.
hints: The most frequent task type is the bottleneck — think about scheduling its occurrences with the cooldown, then filling gaps with everything else.
If the most frequent count is max_count, it creates (max_count - 1) full cooldown blocks of size (n+1), plus however many tasks tie for that max count at the very end.
Compare that formula's result to len(tasks) — you can never do better than one task per time unit even if there's no idle time needed.
